    SUM(CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN orders.id ELSE NULL END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders

SELECT 
    c.id AS category_id,
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS total_profit
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY 
    c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    total_profit DESC
LIMIT 1;
